title: Transparent self-modeling blocks an infinite regress

statements.text: Self-modeling is logically an infinite process: a system modeling itself as modeling itself would generate an endless chain that would consume its resources. Transparent self-modeling evolved as a way of breaking the loop with an untranscendable object. On this principle of necessary self-reification, the phenomenal self is the transparent representational object that blocks the self-representational loop.

sources.quote: it prevents the system from being caught up in an infinite regress of self-modeling
I call this the "principle of necessary self-reification"
